note: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them. Guides are our own words, written for this entry, and every trophy cites its sources.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. The platinum pops by itself the moment the 54th lands — there is no separate task.
steps: Work the roadmap below, stage by stage.
The platinum unlocks with your 54th trophy. Nothing extra to do.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first mission of the game.
steps: Play the opening mission through to its end.
No choices or collectibles gate it.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story. Finish Chapter 1. While you are there, do the Chapter 1 meditation — it is the game's one missable trophy (see Positive Mental Attitude).
steps: Play through Chapter 1's missions.
Before Chapter 1 ends, meditate with Lucia at Jason's house — after the mission Down to Earth, in the morning.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story. Finish Chapter 2. Both characters are playable from here, so the remaining meditation spots open up.
steps: Play through Chapter 2's missions.
After Coffee Break you can play as both Jason and Lucia — meditate with each at the spots you pass.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story. Finish Chapter 3 — it ends after the Vice City sequences. Keep playing the story and the trophy pops at the chapter close; no side tasks are needed for it.
steps: Play through Chapter 3's missions.
Side content you skip now stays open in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story. Finish Chapter 4, the penultimate chapter. Keep playing the story; the trophy pops at the chapter close, and nothing else is required for it.
steps: Play through Chapter 4's missions.
Keep cheats off — a cheat disables trophies and saving.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story. Finish the final mission. After the credits you keep playing in free roam, and the 100% Completion Checklist opens under Progress, then Stats.
steps: Play the final mission to the credits.
After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see what is left.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story. Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears.
steps: Take the mission when it shows up in the story.
Missions cannot be replayed, but story missions cannot be missed — just play them.

sources.n: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist when it appears.
steps: Take the mission when it shows up in the story.
Heist prep missions count toward the story — do them as they come.

sources.n: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story. Complete the mission Child's Play when it appears.
steps: Take the mission when it shows up in the story.
Story missions unlock in order — nothing to prepare in advance.

sources.n: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story. Complete the mission Headliners when it appears.
steps: Take the mission when it shows up in the story.
Story missions unlock in order — nothing to prepare in advance.

sources.n: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown when it appears. The airport (VCIA) is also where Catch Me If You Can happens — see that trophy.
steps: Take the mission when it shows up in the story.
While at the airport, remember the unscheduled-departure trophy for later.

sources.n: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory when it appears.
steps: Take the mission when it shows up in the story.
Story missions unlock in order — nothing to prepare in advance.

sources.n: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy. Reach 100% on the in-game checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), which opens after the story. Progress made during the story already counts. It is closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not needed, and you need 70 of the 80 challenges.
steps: Finish the story first — the checklist only shows after the credits.
Work the checklist: every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest; 70 of 80 challenges.
Scan 200 of 277 base vehicles with WAiNK and study 100 of 255 animals through binoculars along the way.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — any 250 of the 397 in the game count. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so keep going past this trophy.
steps: Use ramps and jumps around Leonida; every stunt you land counts.
Check your count in the tracker below and in-game under Progress.

sources.n: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Easy ones to tick off early: a race, fishing, bowling, an arcade game, a shooting range and a drone race.
steps: Play one of each activity type as you meet it during the story.
The trophy pops once all 9 types have been tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across 12 ranges. Every range is required for 100% too, so this is not a detour.
steps: Visit each of the 12 shooting ranges and gold every challenge.
Replay a challenge until the gold medal lands — replays are free.

sources.n: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location (14 locations). Every drone race is also required for 100%.
steps: Find each Top Fun drone race location and win the race there.
Losing costs nothing — retry until you win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races, out of 40 in the game. Each race only counts once, so vary the events.
steps: Enter races around Leonida and win 20 distinct ones.
Repeating a race you already won does not add to the count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the activity types, so it also feeds Master of None.
steps: Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him.
If you lose, challenge him again — retries are free.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game, start to end. Any arcade cabinet counts.
steps: Find an arcade and play a game through to its end.
It also ticks one activity type toward Master of None.

sources.n: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. Andy's questline is Lucia-only, so play those missions as Lucia when they appear.
steps: Take Andy's missions as Lucia when they appear.
Finish the strand — the trophy pops at the final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. Take his missions when they appear — quest givers tied to a trophy come back after the story.
steps: Take Kenton's missions when they appear.
Finish the strand — the trophy pops at the final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. Take his missions when they appear — quest givers tied to a trophy come back after the story.
steps: Take Billy's missions when they appear.
Finish the strand — the trophy pops at the final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Stranger missions are not part of the 100% checklist, so do them as a cleanup stage.
steps: Pick up stranger missions (marked on the map) and finish each strand.
8 completed strands pop the trophy.

sources.n: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. Take his missions when they appear — quest givers tied to a trophy come back after the story.
steps: Take Randy's missions when they appear.
Finish the strand — the trophy pops at the final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. Tyrone's questline is Jason-only, so play those missions as Jason when they appear.
steps: Take Tyrone's missions as Jason when they appear.
Finish the strand — the trophy pops at the final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — the game's only potentially missable trophy. Meditate at all 18 spots in 10 locations, with both Jason and Lucia. The first meditation — Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house, in Chapter 1 after the mission Down to Earth, in the morning — is gone after that chapter, and it is unconfirmed whether it counts. Do it: it is the safe choice.
steps: CHAPTER 1, after Down to Earth: in the morning, find Lucia at Jason's house and meditate on the balcony. Do not finish Chapter 1 first.
Meditate at the other 17 spots as you find them, with both characters.
The last spot only opens once both characters are playable, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests are all required for 100%, and his questline is Jason-only.
steps: Take Bret's quests as Jason when they appear.
Hunt the unique animal he marks for you.

sources.n: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. The 100% checklist asks for 15 complete sets, so keep collecting past this trophy.
steps: Collect cards around Leonida until 3 full sets are done.
Track your sets in the tracker below.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Scan unfamiliar vehicles and locations with the WAiNK app as you travel — it adds up across the whole game.
steps: Open the WAiNK app whenever you see an unscanned vehicle or location.
Do it as you go: 100 locations is a long grind if left to the end.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges. The 100% checklist asks for 70, so the hardest 10 can be skipped entirely.
steps: Work through the challenge list, easiest first.
Skip the hardest ones — only 70 of 80 are ever needed.

sources.n: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it in open country where you can break line of sight.
steps: Bring your partner along and raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Break line of sight and stay hidden until the heat drops.

sources.n: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops one after another without losing your wanted level. Pick three shops close together and keep moving.
steps: Bring your partner and pick 3 shops on one short route.
Rob them back-to-back, staying wanted the whole time.

sources.n: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scan them with the WAiNK app as you drive around — the 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so keep scanning past this trophy.
steps: Scan every unfamiliar vehicle with WAiNK as you meet it.
100 discovered pops the trophy; 200 scanned feeds the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies bunch together — a gang fight or a robbery shootout.
steps: Find a fight with 5 or more enemies close together.
Trigger Combat Focus and drop all 5 before it ends.

sources.n: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in a vehicle that was not scheduled to depart — take a plane (or another aircraft) and fly out without a booking.
steps: Get to VCIA and get into an aircraft on the airfield.
Take off and leave the airport — no ticket, no schedule.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Rhino tanks roll in when the heat is at its highest. Take one on and come out of the fight — heavy weapons, cover, and distance are your friends.
steps: Raise the heat until a Rhino tank is deployed.
Fight it on your terms — do not stand in the open.

sources.n: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses spotting you before you are out.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry.
Take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape, out of 8 in the game. Bank vaults are also on the 100% checklist, so these do double duty.
steps: Hit 5 different bank vaults and get clear each time.
Plan the escape before you go in — the heat after a vault job is heavy.

sources.n: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop the truck, crack it open, take the cash, and get clear before the response arrives.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road and stop it.
Take the cash and escape before the heat closes in.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive and walk everywhere — the map fills in as you go, and the tracker below counts your progress.
steps: Visit every named area on the map.
Mop up the last few areas in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Gang operations are also on the 100% checklist (39 of them), so this fits the cleanup stage.
steps: Find one illegal operation per gang and rob it.
9 gangs cleared pops the trophy.

sources.n: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Any bar on the beachfront works — sit, order, enjoy the view.
steps: Go to a bar on Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail and take in the view.

sources.n: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight out of a vehicle showroom, through the glass, in classic style. Pick a showroom, build speed, and smash out.
steps: Take a car inside (or into) a vehicle showroom.
Drive it out through the front — glass, noise, style.

sources.n: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. A full game counts — and bowling is also one of the 9 activity types.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a game of bowling through to the end.

sources.n: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership story moment between Jason and Lucia. It pops during the story as their partnership hits a high — just keep playing the story.
steps: Play the story with both characters.
The trophy pops at the partnership beat — no side task needed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make story choices as they come — PlayStation tracks a count of 500 choices across the game, and the count builds up naturally through the story. Not flagged missable by the guides: everything else can be done after the story.
steps: Keep making choices in missions and conversations.
The counter climbs across the whole game — no single choice gates it.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail at something, then succeed on the second try. It pops when a retry lands — a race, a challenge, a mission objective you flubbed once.
steps: Attempt something and fail it once.
Succeed on the immediate second try.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness one of Leonida's strange random events — the unexplained things that happen out in the world. Keep playing and exploring; it pops when you see one.
steps: Explore off the beaten path, especially at odd hours.
The trophy pops the moment you witness a strange event.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Line up a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and keep driving.
steps: Get a vehicle moving at a steady speed.
Land a melee hit on a pedestrian as you drive by.

sources.n: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — launder them steadily instead of sitting on them.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and heists.
Launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean.

sources.n: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything with a price tag. It adds up fast once you start buying gear for the 100% run.
steps: Buy what you need across the shops of Leonida.
$100,000 total spend pops the trophy.

sources.n: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. They are also useful storage for the vehicles you register and discover.
steps: Save up and buy each garage property as you find it.
All 8 owned pops the trophy.

sources.n: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Scan vehicles with WAiNK first, then register the ones you want to keep.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app and register a vehicle.
Repeat for 10 vehicles.
